title: Pedro Scooby and Cintia Dicker's Divorce Finalized
seoTitle: Pedro Scooby and Cintia Dicker's Divorce Finalized
subtitle: Surfer explains marriage 'reached its limit,' couple remains friends
excerpt: Pedro Scooby revealed his marriage to Cintia Dicker ended due to accumulated wear, comparing it to overflowing water. Both maintain a friendly relationship.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: O GLOBO, CNN Brasil, Notícias da TV
contentHtml:
Pedro Scooby and Cintia Dicker have confirmed the end of their marriage after months of separation. The surfer used the metaphor of overflowing water to explain that the relationship reached a point of no return, while the model emphasized her intention to preserve their coexistence with their daughter, Aurora.

What motivated the end of the marriage

According to Scooby, there wasn't an isolated reason that led to the divorce; it was a series of events that ultimately “overflowed.” He compared the situation to water reaching its limit and no longer being containable, indicating that the decision was made when both realized it no longer made sense to stay together.

How they describe the separation

In an interview with the Leo Dias portal, Scooby stated that “there isn't a specific reason” and that “it just happens, there's not much explanation.” He added that the separation was mutual and that there was no infidelity. Dicker, for her part, declared that she remains friends with Scooby, that they still respect and support each other, and that their relationship is now based on friendship and affection.

Pedro Scooby's reactions

The surfer used Instagram stories to clarify that he has been separated for two months, that there was no infidelity, and that they speak daily. Scooby emphasized that “I haven't been with anyone” and that respect for his ex-wife was the reason for speaking directly to the public.

Cintia Dicker's stance

Dicker stated that, despite no longer being a couple, they remain close, loving and respecting each other. She did not rule out the possibility of a future together but left the decision in God's hands. The priority, according to the model, is to maintain the stability and well-being of their daughter, Aurora.

Impact on daughter Aurora

The couple's daughter, Aurora, is three years old. Dicker explained that she chose to live near Scooby to facilitate the girl's routine, allowing Aurora to stay at both her mother's and father's homes with complete freedom. Both agree that close coexistence is essential for the child's development.

With information from O GLOBO, CNN Brasil, Notícias da TV.
